reason: This is a small but central refactor in `pkg/table` that changes the mutability contract of `AddRecordOpt` / `UpdateRecordOpt` / `CreateIdxOpt`, which sit on core row-write and index-write paths. Even with only a few files touched, option-handling changes here can silently alter executor/table runtime behavior, row/index correctness, or write-path invariants across insert/update/index operations, so it is risky enough to justify a focused deep review.
